U Urdu text on temple display sparks protest in Indore

During Janmashtami celebrations in Indore, a display board at the Banke Bihari temple showed Urdu text, leading to protests by Hindu organizations. The police stopped the broadcast and began questioning the operator of the display. The exact content of the Urdu text and the reason for its display are under investigation. Hindu groups have demanded an inquiry into the incident.
